description: Find places by name in Wikidata (CC0) and get their coordinates, description, country, administrative region, population and elevation where recorded, best match first. Cities, towns, landmarks and other places with coordinates. Use before weather, sun or distance lookups, or to tell two places of the same name apart. Example: name=Uppsala. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: geocode
title: Place name to coordinates
